stem.en: To lift that same box by 1.4 m, how much string must you pull in at your hand, in metres?

explanation.en: Both segments must each shorten by 1.4 m, so the hand pulls in 2 × 1.4 = 2.8 m of string.

hints.en: Every metre the box rises, BOTH supporting segments get 1 metre shorter.
String pulled = 2 × (how far the box rises).
